reports.title: Threat Groups
reports.query: MATCH (g:ThreatGroup) RETURN g.name AS Name, g.country AS Country, g.first_seen AS FirstSeen, g.aliases AS Aliases, g.description AS Description ORDER BY g.first_seen

settings.description: All known threat groups from the MITRE ATT&CK dataset

reports.title: Techniques per Tactic
reports.query: MATCH (tac:Tactic)<-[:BELONGS_TO]-(tech:Technique) RETURN tac.name AS Tactic, count(tech) AS TechniqueCount ORDER BY TechniqueCount DESC

settings.description: Number of techniques associated with each MITRE ATT&CK tactic

reports.title: Threat Group Attack Techniques
reports.query: MATCH (g:ThreatGroup)-[r:USES]->(t:Technique) RETURN g, r, t LIMIT 100

settings.description: Interactive graph of threat groups and the attack techniques they employ

reports.title: Full Attack Graph
reports.query: MATCH (g:ThreatGroup)-[r1:USES]->(t:Technique) OPTIONAL MATCH (g)-[r2:USES_SOFTWARE]->(s:Software) OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[r3:BELONGS_TO]->(tac:Tactic) RETURN g, r1, t, r2, s, r3, tac LIMIT 150

settings.description: Complete attack graph showing threat groups, techniques, software, and tactics

reports.title: CVE Severity Table
reports.query: MATCH (c:CVE) RETURN c.id AS CVE_ID, c.name AS Name, c.severity AS Severity, c.cvss AS CVSS, c.affected AS AffectedProduct, c.description AS Description ORDER BY c.cvss DESC

settings.description: Known CVEs sorted by CVSS score (most critical first)

reports.title: Software & Malware Arsenal
reports.query: MATCH (s:Software) RETURN s.name AS Name, s.type AS Type, s.description AS Description ORDER BY s.type, s.name

settings.description: Catalog of malware, tools, and exploits in the dataset

reports.title: Mitigations Inventory
reports.query: MATCH (m:Mitigation) OPTIONAL MATCH (m)-[:MITIGATES]->(t:Technique) RETURN m.name AS Mitigation, m.id AS MitreID, m.description AS Description, collect(t.name) AS MitigatedTechniques ORDER BY m.name

settings.description: All mitigations and the techniques they protect against

reports.title: Mitigation Coverage Graph
reports.query: MATCH (m:Mitigation)-[r:MITIGATES]->(t:Technique) OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[r2:BELONGS_TO]->(tac:Tactic) RETURN m, r, t, r2, tac LIMIT 150

settings.description: Visual map of mitigations and the attack techniques they cover
